text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It feels so good to cross the finish line<n>in the lead!
This is why I could never<n>quit racing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I got to look cool, so I'm<n>super happy with
how that went!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There's a whole storm of wins<n>coming our way,
Trainer, and you've<n>got the best seat in the house.
Just<n>you wait! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm going to train real hard<n>and win the
next race, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! And I'm going to have to<n>aim higher and
higher to make that<n>happen!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
First things first! Time to look back on<n>my
performance today and analyze<n>what I did right and
wrong!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If I want to win first place again, I<n>can't afford to
get lax! Hup!
